AFFECT [[17298303916558156758]]
	TRAVERSE [[254504370080162629]]
		LOCATE BEFORE ALL
		INSERT {
		Rectangle {
			id: smritiEyeUi
			property bool watching: false
			property bool failed: false     // last model call failed (state "watching error")
			property bool armed: false
			// daemon writes "<epoch> <stage>". It is truth: idle = closed eye;
			// looking = open eye; reading/thinking/settling = three dots;
			// inking = pen stroke. Stale/missing = open only while watching.
			property string stage: ""
			property int pulse: 0
			readonly property bool thinking: stage === "reading" || stage === "thinking" || stage === "settling" || stage === "confirming"
			readonly property bool drawing: stage === "inking"
			readonly property bool open: watching && !thinking && !drawing && !failed
			readonly property bool closed: !watching && !thinking && !drawing && !failed
			// Manual control: the eye is INVISIBLE and inert until the
			// Smriti drawer app arms it (writes /home/root/.smriti/armed).
			// Before arming: no eye in any notebook, no capture, no usage.
			visible: smritiEyeUi.armed
			width: 56
			height: 56
			radius: 28
			color: "white"
			border.color: "black"
			border.width: 3
			z: 9999
			// position, chosen in the Smriti app -> settings.json "eye":
			// legacy "bottom-right" (default, reachable with the toolbar
			// minimised) | "bottom-left" | "top-middle", or "x,y" = normalized
			// fractions 0..1 of the free page area (clamped: the eye always
			// stays fully on screen, 18 px from the edges like before)
			property string pos: "bottom-right"
			property real fx: 1
			property real fy: 1
			property real pw: parent ? parent.width : 1404
			property real ph: parent ? parent.height : 1872
			x: 18 + smritiEyeUi.fx * Math.max(0, smritiEyeUi.pw - smritiEyeUi.width - 36)
			y: 18 + smritiEyeUi.fy * Math.max(0, smritiEyeUi.ph - smritiEyeUi.height - 36)

			// idle: shut eyelid. Watching: open pupil. Thinking: pulsing dots.
			// Drawing: diagonal pen/stroke. Each is mutually exclusive.
			Rectangle {
				anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 24; height: 5; radius: 3
				color: "black"; visible: smritiEyeUi.closed
			}
			Rectangle {
				anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 16; height: 16; radius: 8
				color: "black"; visible: smritiEyeUi.open
			}
			Row {
				anchors.centerIn: parent; spacing: 4; visible: smritiEyeUi.thinking
				Repeater { model: 3
					Rectangle { width: 7; height: 7; radius: 4; color: "black"
						opacity: smritiEyeUi.pulse === index ? 1.0 : 0.25 }
				}
			}
			Rectangle {
				anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 25; height: 6; radius: 2; color: "black"
				rotation: -45; visible: smritiEyeUi.drawing
			}
			Rectangle {
				anchors.centerIn: parent; width: 0; height: 0
				border.color: "black"; border.width: 5; rotation: -45
				visible: smritiEyeUi.drawing; x: 34; y: 12
			}
			Text {
				anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "!"; font.pixelSize: 40; font.bold: true
				visible: smritiEyeUi.failed
			}

			Timer {
				interval: 1000
				running: true
				repeat: true
				triggeredOnStart: true
				onTriggered: {
					smritiEyeUi.smritiPoll("smritiStateXhr", "state", smritiEyeUi.smritiStateDone);
					smritiEyeUi.smritiPoll("smritiArmedXhr", "armed", smritiEyeUi.smritiArmedDone);
					smritiEyeUi.smritiPoll("smritiStageXhr", "/tmp/smriti-stage", smritiEyeUi.smritiStageDone);
					smritiEyeUi.smritiPoll("smritiPosXhr", "settings.json", smritiEyeUi.smritiPosDone);
				}
			}
			Timer { interval: 280; running: smritiEyeUi.thinking; repeat: true
				onTriggered: smritiEyeUi.pulse = (smritiEyeUi.pulse + 1) % 3 }

			// ONE request object per polled file, re-opened each tick: a new
			// XMLHttpRequest per tick leaked ~10-17 KB each in xochitl's QML
			// engine -> 6.5 MB/min, OOM kill at 846 MB (device 2026-09-30)
			property var smritiStateXhr: null
			property var smritiArmedXhr: null
			property var smritiStageXhr: null
			property var smritiCmdXhr: null
			property var smritiConfXhr: null
			property var smritiPosXhr: null
			function smritiPoll(slot, file, done) {
				var x = smritiEyeUi[slot];
				if (!x) {
					x = new XMLHttpRequest();
					smritiEyeUi[slot] = x;
				}
				if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.UNSENT && x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
				x.onreadystatechange = done;
				x.open("GET", file.charAt(0) === "/" ? "file://" + file : "file:///home/root/.smriti/" + file);
				x.send();
			}
			function smritiStateDone() {
				var x = smritiEyeUi.smritiStateXhr;
				if (x.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
					smritiEyeUi.watching = (x.responseText.indexOf("watching") === 0);
					smritiEyeUi.failed = (x.responseText.indexOf("error") > 0);
				}
			}
			function smritiArmedDone() {
				var x = smritiEyeUi.smritiArmedXhr;
				if (x.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
					// present + "1" = armed; missing file / "0" = off
					smritiEyeUi.armed = (x.responseText.indexOf("1") === 0);
				}
			}

			function smritiStageDone() {
				var x = smritiEyeUi.smritiStageXhr;
				if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
				var m = String(x.responseText || "").trim().split(/\s+/);
				var ts = parseFloat(m[0]);
				smritiEyeUi.stage = (m.length > 1 && !isNaN(ts) && Date.now() / 1000 - ts < 20) ? m[1] : "";
			}

			function smritiPosDone() {
				var x = smritiEyeUi.smritiPosXhr;
				if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
				var p = "";
				try { p = String(JSON.parse(x.responseText).eye || ""); } catch (e) { p = ""; }
				var f = [1, 1];   // bottom-right (default / unknown)
				if (p === "bottom-left") f = [0, 1];
				else if (p === "top-middle") f = [0.5, 0];
				else {
					var m = p.split(",");
					if (m.length === 2 && !isNaN(parseFloat(m[0])) && !isNaN(parseFloat(m[1])))
						f = [parseFloat(m[0]), parseFloat(m[1])];
				}
				smritiEyeUi.pos = p;
				smritiEyeUi.fx = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, f[0]));
				smritiEyeUi.fy = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, f[1]));
			}

			// one toggle per tap: TapHandler + MouseArea both fired it (start
			// then stop); a second touch within 800 ms is ignored
			property double lastToggle: 0
			function smritiToggle() {
				var now = Date.now();
				if (now - smritiEyeUi.lastToggle < 800) return;
				smritiEyeUi.lastToggle = now;
				console.log("[smriti-eye] tapped, watching=" + smritiEyeUi.watching);
				var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
				xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.smriti/eye-cmd");
				xhr.send(smritiEyeUi.watching ? "stop" : "start");
				smritiEyeUi.watching = !smritiEyeUi.watching;
			}

			MouseArea {
				anchors.fill: parent
				onClicked: smritiEyeUi.smritiToggle()
			}

			// ── confirm window: pops out of the eye when the daemon asks ──
			// Protocol (~/.smriti): confirm.json {id, kind, summary, shown}
			// + confirm.png (what was selected/read) -> Navy edits `shown`,
			// taps Confirm/Discard -> confirm-reply ("confirm\n<text>" |
			// "discard"). The daemon removes the files when done.
			property string confirmId: ""
			property string answeredId: ""
			Rectangle {
				id: smritiConfirm
				visible: smritiEyeUi.confirmId !== ""
				width: 900
				height: 760
				// centred on the eye, kept on the page (same 18 px margins)
				x: Math.max(18, Math.min(smritiEyeUi.pw - width - 18, smritiEyeUi.x + 28 - width / 2)) - smritiEyeUi.x
				// top of the page (y relative to the eye): the on-screen keyboard
				// rises from the bottom and would cover a popup anchored there
				y: 110 - smritiEyeUi.y
				onVisibleChanged: { if (!visible) smritiEyeUi.smritiKeyboardOff(); }
				color: "white"
				border.color: "black"
				border.width: 4
				radius: 12
				property string kind: ""
				property string summary: ""

				Column {
					anchors.fill: parent
					anchors.margins: 24
					spacing: 16
					Rectangle {
						visible: smritiConfirmText.activeFocus
						width: parent.width; height: 70; radius: 10
						color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
						Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Done editing (hide keyboard)"; font.pixelSize: 30 }
						MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiEyeUi.smritiKeyboardOff() }
					}
					Text {
						text: "Monke read (" + smritiConfirm.kind + "): " + smritiConfirm.summary
						font.pixelSize: 30
						width: parent.width
						wrapMode: Text.Wrap
					}
					Image {
						id: smritiConfirmImg
						width: parent.width
						height: 330
						fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
						cache: false
						source: smritiEyeUi.confirmId === "" ? ""
							: "file:///home/root/.smriti/confirm.png?" + smritiEyeUi.confirmId
					}
					Rectangle {
						width: parent.width
						height: 150
						border.color: "black"
						border.width: 2
						TextEdit {
							id: smritiConfirmText
							anchors.fill: parent
							anchors.margins: 10
							font.pixelSize: 28
							wrapMode: TextEdit.Wrap
						}
					}
					Row {
						spacing: 24
						Rectangle {
							width: 400; height: 90; radius: 10
							color: "black"
							Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Confirm"; color: "white"; font.pixelSize: 34 }
							MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiEyeUi.smritiAnswer("confirm\n" + smritiConfirmText.text) }
						}
						Rectangle {
							width: 400; height: 90; radius: 10
							color: "white"; border.color: "black"; border.width: 3
							Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Discard"; font.pixelSize: 34 }
							MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: smritiEyeUi.smritiAnswer("discard") }
						}
					}
				}
			}

			// ── daemon -> xochitl commands (~/.smriti/qml-cmd, root-only file):
			// {"id":n,"cmd":"probe"|"eval","js":"..."} -> result in qml-out
			// ("<id>\n<result>"). Dev channel for pen colour / layer control.
			property string cmdId: ""
			function smritiRun(c) {
				var out = "";
				try {
					if (c.cmd === "eval") {
						out = String(eval(c.js));
					} else if (c.cmd === "probe") {
						out = smritiEyeUi.smritiProbe();
					}
				} catch (e) {
					out = "ERR " + e;
				}
				var w = new XMLHttpRequest();
				w.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.smriti/qml-out");
				w.send(String(c.id) + "\n" + out);
			}

			function smritiProbe() {
				var out = [];
				var names = ["documentViewTools", "sceneController", "toolbar", "documentController"];
				for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
					try {
						out.push(names[i] + " = " + eval(names[i]));
					} catch (e) {
						out.push(names[i] + " ! " + e);
					}
				}
				var keys = ["documentViewTools", "sceneController", "activePen", "currentColor", "activeTool", "toolbar", "selectedPen"];
				var p = smritiEyeUi.parent;
				var d = 0;
				while (p && d < 40) {
					var has = [];
					for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
						try {
							if (p[keys[k]] !== undefined) {
								has.push(keys[k]);
							}
						} catch (e2) {
						}
					}
					out.push(d + ": " + p + (has.length ? "  HAS " + has.join(",") : ""));
					p = p.parent;
					d++;
				}
				return out.join("\n");
			}

			function smritiKeyboardOff() {
				smritiConfirmText.focus = false;
				Qt.inputMethod.hide();
			}

			function smritiAnswer(body) {
				smritiEyeUi.smritiKeyboardOff();
				var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
				xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.smriti/confirm-reply");
				xhr.send(body);
				smritiEyeUi.answeredId = smritiEyeUi.confirmId;
				smritiEyeUi.confirmId = "";
			}

			Timer {
				interval: 150
				running: smritiEyeUi.armed
				repeat: true
				onTriggered: {
					smritiEyeUi.smritiPoll("smritiCmdXhr", "qml-cmd", smritiEyeUi.smritiCmdDone);
					smritiEyeUi.smritiPoll("smritiConfXhr", "confirm.json", smritiEyeUi.smritiConfDone);
				}
			}
			function smritiCmdDone() {
				var cx = smritiEyeUi.smritiCmdXhr;
				if (cx.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
				var c = null;
				try { c = JSON.parse(cx.responseText); } catch (e) { c = null; }
				if (!c || String(c.id) === smritiEyeUi.cmdId) return;
				smritiEyeUi.cmdId = String(c.id);
				smritiEyeUi.smritiRun(c);
			}
			function smritiConfDone() {
				var x = smritiEyeUi.smritiConfXhr;
				if (x.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
				var r = null;
				try { r = JSON.parse(x.responseText); } catch (e) { r = null; }
				if (!r) { smritiEyeUi.confirmId = ""; return; }
				var id = String(r.id);
				if (id === smritiEyeUi.confirmId || id === smritiEyeUi.answeredId) return;
				smritiConfirm.kind = r.kind || "";
				smritiConfirm.summary = r.summary || "";
				smritiConfirmText.text = r.shown || "";
				smritiEyeUi.confirmId = id;
			}
		}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
